conditions.title: Classification gate and allow-list before the surface
conditions.why: restricted content may reach the model output, so the input surface must be restricted to classified, allow-listed material.
conditions.residual_limitation: A gate is only as good as the labels it reads; one misclassified input defeats it.

conditions.title: DLP and egress allow-list on prompts and responses
conditions.why: Confidentiality loss is the primary failure mode at this tier.
conditions.residual_limitation: DLP misses paraphrased secrets and novel formats; it reduces, never eliminates, leakage.

conditions.title: DPIA / data-protection assessment before production
conditions.why: Personal data processing triggers a documented assessment.
conditions.residual_limitation: A DPIA records a decision; it is not itself a control.

conditions.title: Residency and transfer mechanism pinned in contract and config
conditions.why: Processing crosses a border, so location and transfer basis must be fixed, not assumed.
conditions.residual_limitation: Residency attestations often omit backup, replication and support-access regions.

conditions.title: No-train and zero-retention terms, evidenced not declared
conditions.why: A third party receives the data, so retention and training use must be contractually barred and technically confirmed.
conditions.residual_limitation: A no-train clause does not prove deletion, nor stop on-path logging by a subcontractor.

conditions.title: Resilience, exit plan and concentration limits (DORA-style)
conditions.why: A critical function cannot depend on a supplier it cannot leave.
conditions.residual_limitation: An exit plan untested at scale is a document, not resilience.

conditions.title: Supervisory audit trail and incident reporting path
conditions.why: Supervisors will ask who did what and when.
conditions.residual_limitation: An audit trail proves an action occurred, not that it was appropriate.

conditions.title: Human review in the loop for restricted outputs
conditions.why: At this consequence, an unreviewed output is not acceptable.
conditions.residual_limitation: Review degrades to rubber-stamping as volume grows.

conditions.title: Least-privilege roles and SSO-bound access
conditions.why: The surface must not exceed the user's own entitlements.
conditions.residual_limitation: Role drift and shared accounts quietly exceed the intended boundary.

conditions.title: Logging and provenance on every model interaction
conditions.why: Without a record, neither misuse nor benefit is provable.
conditions.residual_limitation: Logs prove the interaction happened, not that it was appropriate.

conditions.title: Staged rollout behind a bounded pilot with stop criteria
conditions.why: The measured residual (80.3/100) does not support an unbounded production launch.
conditions.residual_limitation: A pilot ticks a box unless it has a pre-agreed abort threshold.
